purpose: scripted-gait ground-truth distance for contact/current pricing calibration (HARDWARE.md backlog item 1)
operator_notes: power-tethered, no extension cord: legs run as 10 s halves, robot repositioned between

legs.contamination: crooked stance (bad logical zero), front foot dragging; start mark may predate the direction nudge (+~70mm)

legs.stance: fresh hand-set zero -> ARM -> P; preflight 0.8 deg from plant, roll 1.1 pitch 3.1 at start

legs.observation: L5 swing foot not lifting enough - colliding/stuck on floor, blocking travel (operator)

higher steps but feet sometimes not reaching ground (late/soft touchdown); L5 still dragging a bit (its ~6deg-low hip eats ~20mm of clearance). KEY: slip ratio unchanged vs 25mm lift -> distance loss dominated by loaded stance-foot slide, not swing drag

floor: operator to confirm (same runway all session)

findings.slip_ratio: 0.50-0.51 across 5 valid runs; invariant to speed (30/50 mm/s) and swing lift (25/40 mm)
findings.mechanism: distance loss dominated by loaded stance-foot slide (paddle), NOT swing-foot drag: lift 25->40mm changed nothing; L5 swing drag present but not the driver
findings.walk_current: 0.31-0.42 A mean / 0.68-0.85 A peak, ~flat vs speed; consistent with 08-09 walking-cheaper-than-standing
findings.hardware_notes: L5 hip reads ~6 deg low vs tripod-mates (leg with the replaced knee servo ID19) -> ~20mm lost swing clearance, drags at default lift; fix L5 zero or per-joint trim. Loaded sag: knees pull under when robot lifted (load-dependent tracking error, matches loaded-actuator gap)
findings.contaminated_runs: leg1a only (crooked stance from bad hand-set zero; front foot dragging)
